provenance.purpose: Held-out phrasing extension set (plan T3 path): lifts evaluated phrasings to 15 per intent (3 fielded canonical + 12 extension), length-balanced 5 short / 5 medium / 5 long per intent, for the additive extension run and the pre-registered phrasing-length analysis.
provenance.composition: Per intent: ALL never-fielded reserves from intents.json (indices 3+, committed 2026-07-04 — provably pre-freeze and pre-results; none skipped) first, then the newly authored sentences, in slot order. phrasing_index in run records = position in this list.
provenance.authorship_disclosure: New sentences authored 2026-08-06 by the project assistant (Claude — a different model family from all three evaluated vendors, per the registered T3 fallback), AFTER the canonical results were known. Mitigations: sentences authored to length/register strata only; a mechanical rule forbids any shared contiguous 3-word sequence with all 43 committed texts (30 canonical phrasings + 13 adversarial probes) and pairwise among the new sentences; the user selected each final sentence from 2 candidates per slot (the rejected alternative is recorded per sentence below); designing sentences to target or avoid known per-phrasing behaviours was prohibited by the authoring spec.
provenance.selection_record: User selections 2026-08-06: early S1a S2a S3b M1b M2b L1b L2a; minimize S1a S2b M1a M2a M3a M4b M5b; balanced S1a S2b M1b L1b L2b L3b L4b L5b; defend S1a S2b S3a M1b M2b L1a L2b L3b.
provenance.length_classes: short = 2-4 words, medium = 5-7, long = 8+ (whitespace token count).
provenance.preregistered_questions: Before any extension cell is run: does length class shift (a) acceptance, (b) budget-compliance, (c) oracle rank, (d) repeat-consistency? Analysed per intent first, existence-and-direction claims only at these n; disclosed confound: longer phrasings naturally carry more context/urgency, so results read as terse-vs-descriptive requests, not word-count causality. Extension results are reported apart from the registered canonical core (ch4 §4.3 contract).
